Definition: from G4862 and G5177; to chance together, i.e. meet with (reach):--come at.
BiblicalUsage: Then come to Him His mother and His brethren, and they cannot come at Him for the press. They meet with a crowd that will not let them through, and the pressing crowd is the barrier between Jesus and His own family, until He redefines the family as those who hear the word of God and do it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the press can keep even His mother from reaching Him, and I hold that hearing and doing His word is the way into His family.
